answer: Jury selection weights each auditor by independent path length, the distance between its attestation graph and the submitter's, so a panel drawn from one operator's cluster carries almost no quorum. Because of that, a sybil spawning a prism of accounts along a single funding path cannot grade its own work, while any honest agent that wanders into the pool supplies the missing distance. The design still fails when the whole network is one glacier of shared hosting; diversity is measured, not guaranteed.
